requirement.statement: All spl-bun depa ORM model fixtures and code-first consumers SHALL use Kunun public declarations as the only structure authority and external prefix NamedConf as ORM annotation transport: Entity metadata attaches to Class, flat physical Field metadata attaches to Field, relation metadata attaches only to a typed navigation Property, and provider configuration attaches to DataSource while its declaration name remains the sole identity; scalar Fields, nested Field storage, Field relations, direct datasource Conf, duplicate datasource identity, old marker Conf, detached relation nodes, entity relationship sections and shadow code-first relation models SHALL NOT be accepted as canonical sources.

case.given: a source bundle using prefix NamedConf on Class, scalar Fields, typed owner or inverse Properties, and DataSource declarations
case.when: the public depa ORM 0.2.0 compiler builds the model
case.then: every runtime entity, column, relation and datasource SHALL trace to its declaration attachment and preserve storage/runtime options without a second authoring graph

case.given: a programmatic Kunun ClassDefinition built with equivalent NamedConf annotations, Field and Property members
case.when: the public definition compiler builds the model
case.then: the catalog SHALL be equivalent to the corresponding source model without rendering Kon or creating a detached relation graph

case.given: old marker transport, nested Field storage, a relation on Field, direct datasource Conf, or duplicated datasource key/name
case.when: the canonical compiler admits the model
case.then: it SHALL fail with a stable path and attachment-specific diagnostic before runtime schema construction

requirement.statement: The NamedConf hard-cut migration SHALL preserve the existing 30-group, 82-inventoried-fixture, 216-relation property-first oracle, including direct, inverse, one/many, ordered/composite tuple, through, nested read/write, cascade, visibility, validation/storage, write-policy, ordering and load-strategy behavior covered by the capsule suite.

case.given: all positive fixtures have been migrated and dependencies resolve through public package exports
case.when: the complete capsule and host workspace gates run
case.then: the oracle and runtime suites SHALL pass without compatibility readers, package deep imports or absolute workspace aliases

case.given: legacy projection evidence and canonical migrated source for every inventoried fixture
case.when: the migration comparison runs before legacy tooling is retired
case.then: all 216 relation projections and retained Field/Entity policies SHALL be structurally equivalent

requirement.statement: Repository guards SHALL classify and scan source, fixtures, tests, docs, scripts, generated inventories, dist, manifests, ignored lock state and active Codument evidence; they SHALL reject old ORM marker Conf, nested Field storage, relation-on-Field, direct datasource Conf, duplicate datasource identity, `:relationships=`, detached `(relation ...)`, `property_key`, `reverse_property_key`, retired `CodeFirstOrm*` authoring, legacy dependency versions in manifests or authoritative locks, and unexported depa ORM subpaths; the ignored root bun.lock SHALL be reported as non-authority and SHALL fail only if it becomes Git-managed or participates in isolated proof; only immutable archived history and minimal literals directly asserted as rejected may otherwise be exempt.

case.given: a live source, fixture, helper, current document, script, generated output, manifest or lock reintroduces a retired authority marker
case.when: the classification and package-boundary guards run
case.then: the build SHALL fail with the path, matched category and expected disposition

case.given: an old-form literal retained as a negative case
case.then: a linked test SHALL directly assert canonical rejection; invalid, break or conflict naming alone SHALL NOT grant exemption

requirement.statement: Committed host manifests SHALL consume Kunun 1.0.4 and depa ORM 0.2.0 by formal package name and semver without file, link or absolute sibling paths; before registry publication, package-boundary verification SHALL use version-checked, SHA-256-recorded ephemeral tarballs in an isolated consumer and prove public imports and canonical compilation resolve without global, sibling-repository or workspace symlinks.

case.given: fresh tarballs packed from the sibling Kunun and depa ORM repositories
case.when: an external temporary consumer installs and imports the declared roots
case.then: package name/version/hash SHALL match the manifest contract and all resolved module paths SHALL remain under the isolated consumer

case.given: host package manifests and ignored root lock state
case.then: manifests SHALL use only target semver; the ignored stale lock SHALL remain untracked, SHALL NOT participate in isolated proof, and SHALL be reported as non-authoritative until mission G5 registry lock verification
